title.narrative: Port Moresby Power Grid Development Project

description.narrative: The proposed Port Moresby Grid Development Project will upgrade and extend the transmission and distribution grid in the national capital, Port Moresby, thereby improving the reliability and quality of power supply to the main urban center in Papua New Guinea (PNG), improving the energy efficiency of power delivery, and enabling delivery of essential power to rapidly expanding areas of Port Moresby. A project preparation technical assistance (PPTA) will be undertaken for the due diligence of the proposed project.

Output: 4. Upgrade Port Moresby's 11kV Distribution Grid by 2025. Indicator: Extend the grid to an estimated 3000 additional Household by 2025 Progress/Status: Target is to connect an additional 3,000 customers to the PPL grid in NCD and Central Province in line with the Government of PNG (GoPNG) Strategic Development Plan for increasing electricity access to 70% of the population by 2030. This component is fully funded by GoPNG as part of its contribution towards the counterpart fund. Phase-I had targeted 870 household connections, which is completed. Phase-II had aimed for the remaining 2,250 households, which is currently on hold due to unavailability of funding. However, GoPNG advised PPL to utilize whatever savings from GoPNG allocation to progress connection and meet the balance of targeted HH before loan closing. Data Source: PPL quarterly Reports Actual value:
